name: orbit-meet
description: Orbit — open, self-hostable video meeting platform (WebRTC + LiveKit SFU)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @orbit/api && npm run build -w @orbit/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @orbit/shared && npm run test -w @orbit/api && npm run test -w @orbit/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @orbit/api && npm run lint -w @orbit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @orbit/api && npm run typecheck -w @orbit/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis livekit coturn
